AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  MAY 4, 2021
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF THE
GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20, N-29-20, AND N-35-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO
VIDEOCONFERENCED WITHOUT PROVIDING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS
DURING A MEETING, EITHER SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR CALL (669) 900-
6833; MEETING ID: 709 573 2685 DURING THE MEETING TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM. THE MEETING MAY BE
VIEWED ON FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT:
https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-393.
  5:00 PM
  VIDEOCONFERENCE
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Jennifer Perez, Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Vice Mayor
  Rick Ramirez, Councilmember
  Margarita L. Rios, Councilmember
  Ana Valencia, Councilmember
  Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
  the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
  subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
  minutes.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
  matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
  has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  STUDY SESSION MEETING – 5:00 p.m.
 CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS

CLOSED SESSION

  I.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54957(a):
  THREAT TO PUBLIC SERVICES OR FACILITIES – Consultation with the City Manager, Los Angeles
  County Sheriff representative, and other related City officials.

  II.  CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY NEGOTIATOR PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE
  §54956.8: Assessor Parcel Number 8047-005-903; Negotiating on behalf of the City: Jesus M. Gomez,
  City Manager; Negotiating Party: Wilshire Group Funding; Under Negotiation: Price and Terms of
  Payment.

  III.  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54957.6; CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR.
  Negotiating on behalf of the City: Jesus M. Gomez, City Manager; regarding negotiations with the
  Norwalk City Employees Association.

RECESS

  REGULAR MEETING – 6:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

INVOCATION
  Margarita L. Rios
  Councilmember

FLAG SALUTE
  Rick Ramirez
  Councilmember

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS – None.

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS

  1.  COVID-19 Update.

  2.  Senior Center Parking Lot Bingo Recap.

  3.  Street Rehabilitation Project Update.

  4.  CalRecycle presentation.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT
 CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES ON THE AGENDA - Staff recommends City Council
  waive reading in full of all ordinances on the agenda and declare that said titles which appear on the
  public agenda shall be determined to have been read by title and further reading waived.

  2.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meetings of April 20,
  22, and 27, 2021. 825-04

  Minutes

  3.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period March 21, 2021 – April 3,
  2021, in the total amount of $875,173.05. 630

  Report

  4.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period April
  15 - April 28, 2021, in the total amount of $4,424,242.93. 640

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  5.  ADVISORY BODIES – Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200

  Report

PUBLIC HEARING

  6.  RESOLUTION NO. 21-23 – APPROVING THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT AND
  HOME FISCAL YEAR 2021-22 ANNUAL ACTION PLAN AND AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER
  TO EXECUTE AND TRANSMIT ALL REQUIRED DOCUMENTS TO THE UNITED STATES
  DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT - Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 21-23, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK APPROVING THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT AND HOME
  FISCAL YEAR 2021/22 ANNUAL ACTION PLAN, AN APPLICATION FOR CDBG, AND HOME
  FUNDING FOR FISCAL YEAR 2021/22 AND AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER TO
  EXECUTE AND TRANSMIT ALL REQUIRED DOCUMENTS TO THE UNITED STATES
  DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT;

  b.  authorize the City Manager to execute agreements and any amendments, in a form approved by
  the City Attorney, with social service agencies for the provision of services funded under the
  Annual Action Plan; and

  c.  authorize the Director of Community Development to execute Memorandum of Understanding with
  City Departments and homeless referral organizations for the provision of services funded under
  the Annual Action Plan.
  ORDINANCE

  Report

  7.  ORDINANCE NO. 21-1725 - AMENDING NORWALK MUNICIPAL CODE CHAPTER 1.13 RELATING
  TO HEARINGS CONTESTING ADMINISTRATIVE CITATIONS AND ADDING CHAPTER 2.18 –
  ESTABLISHING A HOUSING AND BUILDING LOCAL APPEALS BOARD - Staff recommends that
  City Council introduce Ordinance No. 21-1725, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF NORWALK
  ADDING A NEW CHAPTER 2.18 TO THE NORWALK MUNICIPAL CODE ESTABLISHING A
  HOUSING AND BUILDING LOCAL APPEALS BOARD AND AMENDING NORWALK MUNICIPAL
  CODE CHAPTER 1.13 RELATING TO HEARINGS CONTESTING ADMINISTRATIVE CITATIONS.
   Report

REPORTS

  8.  6th CYCLE HOUSING ELEMENT UPDATE – STATUS UPDATE - Staff recommends City Council
  receive and file this report.

  Report

  9.  FIRESTONE BILLBOARD UPDATE - Staff recommends City Council receive and file this report.

  Report

  10. CORONAVIRUS PANDEMIC – MAY EMERGENCY OPERATIONS CENTER UPDATE – Receive and
  file. 710-07

  Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated April 29, 2021.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
